PlayerGeneratorBubbles.description: PlayerGeneratorBubbles contains the map positions used as spawn-grid centers, optionally organized into named groups.

group.description: Groups are named sets of centers used by group-based spawn selection.

PlayerGeneratorParams.description: PlayerGeneratorParams defines the rectangular sampling grid around each generator position and filters candidate points by water, nearby geometry, and terrain slope.

allow_in_water.description: AllowInWater permits candidate points in water when set to a true value.

grid_density.description: GridDensity sets the density of candidate samples across the generated rectangle.

grid_height.description: GridHeight sets the generated rectangle's total height, in meters.

grid_width.description: GridWidth sets the generated rectangle's total width, in meters.

max_dist_static.description: MaxDistStatic is the upper distance from buildings used to rate a valid candidate point, in meters.

max_steepness.description: MaxSteepness is the maximum terrain slope accepted for a candidate.

min_dist_static.description: MinDistStatic is the minimum distance from buildings required for a candidate point to be valid, in meters.

min_steepness.description: MinSteepness is the minimum terrain slope accepted for a candidate.

PlayerGroupParams.description: PlayerGroupParams controls rotation through named groups of spawn centers.

counter.description: Counter is how many player spawns in the active group reset its lifetime. A value of -1 disables the counter.

enablegroups.description: EnableGroups enables group-based point selection. When disabled, points are treated as a regular candidate list.

groups_as_regular.description: GroupsAsRegular allows points inside groups to be used as regular spawn candidates instead of being selected only through group rotation.

lifetime.description: Lifetime is how long a selected group remains active before CE rotates to another group. A value of -1 disables the timer.

PlayerSpawnGroup.description: PlayerSpawnGroup defines one named spawn region and the centers used to generate candidate points in that region.

lifetime.description: Lifetime overrides the shared group lifetime, in seconds. A value of -1 disables the group timer.

name.description: Name identifies the region for selection, configuration, and diagnostics.

pos.description: Pos are centers around which the generator creates candidate spawn grids.

PlayerSpawnParams.description: PlayerSpawnParams provides runtime distance bands used to rate candidate points.

max_dist_infected.description: MaxDistInfected is the distance from infected beyond which extra distance no longer improves the candidate's rating, in meters.

max_dist_player.description: MaxDistPlayer is the distance from other players beyond which extra distance no longer improves the candidate's rating, in meters.

max_dist_static.description: MaxDistStatic is the upper end of the favorable distance band from static geometry, in meters.

max_dist_trigger.description: MaxDistTrigger is the upper end of the favorable distance band from trigger volumes, in meters.

min_dist_infected.description: MinDistInfected is the minimum allowed distance from infected, in meters.

min_dist_player.description: MinDistPlayer is the minimum allowed distance from other players, in meters.

min_dist_static.description: MinDistStatic is the minimum allowed distance from buildings and other static geometry, in meters.

min_dist_trigger.description: MinDistTrigger is the minimum allowed distance from trigger volumes, in meters.

PlayerSpawnPointsFile.description: PlayerSpawnPointsFile configures candidate locations and selection rules for fresh-character, server-hop, and travel spawns.

fresh.description: Fresh configures locations and selection rules for newly created characters.

hop.description: Hop configures locations and selection rules for characters returning after connecting to another server.

playerspawnpoints.description: XMLName identifies the required `<playerspawnpoints>` document root.

travel.description: Travel configures locations and selection rules for characters moved between servers in a travel connection.

PlayerSpawnPos.description: PlayerSpawnPos stores one horizontal map coordinate used as a spawn-grid center.

x.description: X is the map's horizontal X coordinate.

z.description: Z is the map's horizontal Z coordinate.

PlayerSpawnProfile.description: PlayerSpawnProfile defines spawn selection and candidate generation for one player category: fresh characters, same-map server hops, or map travel.

generator_params.description: GeneratorParams defines how candidate points are generated around the configured centers and which terrain or geometry is acceptable.

generator_posbubbles.description:
GeneratorPosBubbles lists the map positions around which the generator builds candidate spawn grids.
Positions can be grouped for group-based selection.

group_params.description: GroupParams enables rotating groups of spawn centers and sets their shared lifetime and reuse counter.

spawn_params.description: SpawnParams scores candidate points by their distance from players, infected, buildings, and trigger volumes at spawn time.
